async function obtainEightJungleLogs(bot) {
    // This function checks if the bot already possesses at least eight jungle logs. If not, it calculates how many more are required. It first searches for the necessary number of jungle logs within a 32-block radius. If none are found nearby, it explores the area until a jungle log is located. Finally, it mines the remaining required number of jungle logs and verifies that the total count reaches eight.
}
